# Gingerbread Theme for Vikunja 🎄

A Christmas and holiday theme for Vikunja, with gingerbread window cards, icing details, festive ribbons, and evergreen backgrounds.

This is an unofficial themed fork of [Vikunja](https://github.com/go-vikunja/vikunja). Vikunja is developed and maintained by its original contributors; this fork adds the Gingerbread theme.
